    @pytest.mark.priority(22)
    @allure.title("Water Target plus/minus button functionality")
    @allure.description("Test plus/minus buttons increment/decrement correctly based on unit (oz or ml).")
    def test_22_water_target_plus_minus_buttons(self):
        page = self.set_targets_page
    
        config = page.get_water_unit_config()
        unit = config["unit"]
        increment = config["increment"]
        max_value = config["max_value"]
        min_value = config["min_value"]
    
        page.input_box.fill("200")
        page.save_water_btn.click()
    
        initial_val = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        assert initial_val >= min_value, f"Initial value {initial_val} below minimum {min_value}"
    
        page.plus_btn.click()
        val_after_plus = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        expected_after_plus = min(initial_val + increment, max_value)
        assert val_after_plus == expected_after_plus, \
            f"Expected {expected_after_plus}, but got {val_after_plus}. Unit: {unit}, increment: {increment}"
    
        page.minus_btn.click()
        val_after_minus = int(page.input_box.input_value())
        expected_after_minus = max(val_after_plus - increment, min_value)
